name: Kunimi (Japan)
description: A blue field charged at the centre with the Kunimi town emblem in white: three outlined lozenges linked in a row.
history: Municipal flag of Kunimi, a town in Fukushima Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 19 September 1955.

features.role: Kunimi town emblem — three outlined lozenges linked in a row
